header.title: Runtime Settings & Endpoints
header.subtitle: Configure live LLM model providers and endpoints without restart.

language.title: Language
language.hint: The language of the screens. Clones still reply in the language you write to them in.
language.saveFailed: Something went wrong saving the language.

setAside.notice: This version could not open your saved settings. When you saved here, it kept that file unchanged beside the new one, so settings saved before, such as API keys, are not shown here.

feedback.saved: Settings successfully applied! Live agents and tools hot-reloaded.
feedback.installJoined: Installed model "{model}" (an install was already running; this joined it).
feedback.installStopped: Stopped waiting for "{model}". Ollama may still be downloading it.
feedback.confirmDelete: Delete model "{model}"? This cannot be undone.
feedback.deleteStopped: Stopped waiting for the removal of "{model}".

failure.load: The settings could not be loaded.
failure.test: The connection could not be tested.
failure.save: Something went wrong saving the settings.
failure.install: Something went wrong installing the model.
failure.remove: Something went wrong deleting the model.
failure.diagnosticsRead: Problem reporting could not be loaded.
failure.diagnosticsChoice: Something went wrong saving your choice.
failure.diagnosticsClear: Something went wrong deleting the recorded failures.

llm.title: LLM Provider
llm.endpointCloudHint: Connects directly to the official {name} API by default. Fill this in only if you use a custom proxy.
llm.ollamaNotAnswering: No model list came back from {endpoint}. Is Ollama running at this address? On this computer its address is usually http://localhost:11434.
llm.vllmNotAnswering: No model list came back from {endpoint}. Check that the vLLM server is running and that the address is right.
llm.vllmKeyRefused: The vLLM server at {endpoint} is running, but it refused the API key. Check the key and paste it again.
llm.ollamaNoModels: Ollama is running but has no models installed. Install one below.
llm.fastHint: Used for quick background work, such as choosing who speaks next in a conversation. A clone that names its own model keeps it.

envOverride.provider: The environment variable {variable} is set, so it takes priority over the provider chosen here. Saving keeps your choice for when the variable is removed.
envOverride.model: The environment variable {variable} is set, so it takes priority over the model chosen here. Saving keeps your choice for when the variable is removed.
envOverride.baseUrl: The environment variable {variable} is set, so it takes priority over the endpoint entered here. Saving keeps your choice for when the variable is removed.

catalog.refreshFailed: The model list could not be refreshed.
catalog.notInList: This model isn't in {vendor}'s list for your key. Check the spelling. You can still save it.
catalog.retired: {model} is no longer offered by {vendor}. Switch to {recommended}?
catalog.noKey: Enter your {vendor} API key below to load the models it can use.
catalog.keyRejected: {vendor} did not accept the API key, so its models could not be listed. Check the key and paste it again.
catalog.keyMalformed: That doesn't look like a {vendor} API key. Check it and paste it again.
catalog.unreachable: Couldn't get {vendor}'s model list. Check your internet connection, then refresh the list.
catalog.noListing: {vendor} did not list any models for this key.
catalog.emptyList: {vendor} listed no chat models for this key.
catalog.unavailable: {vendor}'s model list isn't available right now.

models.title: Manage Local Models
models.installWait: Large models take a while. Cancelling — or closing this window — stops the wait, not the download. Reopen Settings to see whether it arrived.
models.saveToManage: Save first to install or remove models at this address.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.vllmOptional: optional — only if you started the server with --api-key
apiKey.consoleTitle: Get an API key from the {name} console
apiKey.keepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep current key, or enter new key
apiKey.valid: This looks like a valid {name} key.
apiKey.otherProvider: This looks like a {detected} key. Check that it is a {expected} key.
apiKey.badPattern: This is not a valid {name} key. Check its length and characters.
apiKey.removeFailed: The key could not be removed.
apiKey.inUse: This key is in use. Switch to another provider first, or paste a new key to replace it.
apiKey.unknownProvider: That provider is not one Settings knows.

costTips.gemini: Google AI Studio issues a free-tier key (15 requests per minute) without a credit card.
costTips.anthropic: Create a key under API Keys in the Anthropic Console (requires purchased credits).
costTips.openai: Create a secret key under API Keys on the OpenAI Platform.

remoteGpu.title: Remote GPU Worker (SSH Auto-Tunnel)
remoteGpu.hint: Automatically establish an SSH tunnel to a remote workstation (e.g. Dell RTX 5070 Ti). Image generation runs there; the LLM stays where it is unless you tick the box below.
remoteGpu.noPorts: No active remote services detected on port 11434 or 8188.
remoteGpu.useForLlm: Also run the LLM on this worker (Ollama)
remoteGpu.llmModelMissing: The LLM stays local: the selected model isn't installed on the worker.

comfyui.title: ComfyUI Image Generation Endpoint
comfyui.hint: Points to local or LAN GPU workstation running ComfyUI with standard txt2img workflows.

folders.title: Folders Clones Can Read
folders.workspaceHint: Clones read and write their files here.
folders.othersHint: Clones' file tools can open files in these folders but not change or delete them. A clone that can run shell commands is not limited by this list.
folders.envIntro: Also readable, set by UCLONE_READ_ROOTS when the app started:
folders.unsaved: Folder changes take effect when you save.

developerMode.title: Developer mode
developerMode.hint: Adds a drawer of developer tools to the workspace dock (Knowledge Graph, DAG, EventBus and Ontology) and a Diagnostics section below (ACP and Evals). Takes effect at once and is kept in this browser.

connectivity.title: Connectivity Test Results
connectivity.keyRefused: The server is running, but it refused the API key.
